get_seo_configuration_section.code:
response = client.seo_configuration.get_seo_configuration_section("url_settings")
url_settings = response.map["url_settings"]
print(url_settings["regenerate_url_on_item_update"], url_settings["auto_redirect_on_url_change"])
for redirect in url_settings["redirects"]["items"]:
    print(redirect["id"], redirect["source_url"], redirect["destination_url"])

get_seo_configuration_document_root.code:
response = client.seo_configuration.get_seo_configuration_document_root({"limit": 100})
for document_root_file in response.map["items"]:
    print(document_root_file["config_key"], document_root_file["file_name"], document_root_file["file_path"])
print(response.map["pagination"]["has_next"])

upload_seo_configuration_document_root.code:
with open("verification.txt", "rb") as handle:
    response = client.seo_configuration.upload_seo_configuration_document_root({"file": handle})
document_root_file = response.map["document_root_file"]
print(document_root_file["config_key"], document_root_file["file_name"], document_root_file["file_path"])

get_seo_configuration_redirects.code:
response = client.seo_configuration.get_seo_configuration_redirects({"limit": 100})

print(response.map["pagination"]["has_next"])
